```{r libraries}
library(readxl)
library(pheatmap)
library(dplyr)
library(DESeq2)
library(volcanoPlot)



```

```{r load in file}
library(readxl)
Copy_of_NCI_raw_counts <- read_excel("Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-UniversityofNewEngland/Copy of NCI_raw_counts.xlsx")
View(Copy_of_NCI_raw_counts)

```

```{r data manipulation}
#change data to matrix and remove columns with characters
nci_counts <- as.matrix(Copy_of_NCI_raw_counts[,c(-1,-10)])
#change to data frame
nci_counts <- as.data.frame(nci_counts)
#rename rows to Ensembl IDs
row.names(nci_counts) <- Copy_of_NCI_raw_counts$Ensembl_ID
#remove 0s
nci_counts <- nci_counts[rowSums(nci_counts) > 0,]
#subset only TNBC only cultures for comparison
TNBC <- nci_counts[,c(3:7)]

```

```{r make column data}
TNBC.col_data <- as.data.frame(matrix(nrow = 5, ncol = 2))
#name columns
colnames(TNBC.col_data) <- c('patient_ID','type_BC')
TNBC.col_data[,1] <- colnames(TNBC)
TNBC.col_data[,2] <- c('TNBC')

#convert variables to factors
TNBC.col_data$type_BC <- factor(TNBC.col_data$type_BC)

```

```{r DESeq}
#define experimental design or formula
design <- ~type_BC

#import data using DESeq
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = TNBC, colData = TNBC.col_data, design = ~ 1)

dds <- DESeq(dds)

results <- results(dds)

significant_results <- subset(results, padj < 0.05 & abs(log2FoldChange) > 1)

# Explore the significant results
head(significant_results)
```
```{r results}
#get list of upregulated genes
upreg_genes <- subset(rownames(results), results$pvalue < 0.05 & results$log2FoldChange > 1)

#get list of downregulated genes
downreg_genes <- subset(rownames(results), results$pvalue < 0.05 & results$log2FoldChange < -1)

#extract normalized counts
deseq_counts <- counts(dds, normalized=TRUE)

#get count table containing only DEGs
deg_counts <- subset(deseq_counts, row.names(deseq_counts) %in% upreg_genes | row.names(deseq_counts) %in% downreg_genes)


```

```{r Heat Map, echo=FALSE}
#create heatmap object (silent plotting)
DEG_heatmap <-pheatmap(deg_counts, show_rownames=FALSE,
         cluster_cols=FALSE, scale = 'row', cluster_rows=TRUE, labels_row = rownames(upreg_genes), silent = TRUE)

#extract clusters
clust_out <- as.data.frame(as.character(cutree(DEG_heatmap$tree_row,k=3)))
rownames(clust_out) <- rownames(deg_counts)
colnames(clust_out) <- 'cluster'
clust_out$cluster <- as.factor(clust_out$cluster)

#re-plot heatmap with clusters 
pheatmap(deg_counts, show_rownames=FALSE,
         cluster_cols=FALSE, scale = 'row', cluster_rows=TRUE, annotation_row = clust_out,treeheight_row = 0)

#order clusters 
clusters <- arrange(clust_out, clust_out$cluster)

#export clusters as csv 
write.csv(clusters, 'test_clusters')

```

```{r volcano plot}
#turn results into a table
res_df <- as.data.frame(results)
#to add a column: (make sure to check the rownames (ID) and gene names line up) 
res_df$new_col_name <- nci_counts$gene_names
#install package
install.packages('EnhancedVolcano')
#to make a volcano plot: 
volcano
if (!require("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
    install.packages("BiocManager")

BiocManager::install("EnhancedVolcano")

library(EnhancedVolcano)





```
